permutation_negative_control.interpretation: 跨分辨率不得用 particle/material array index 对齐；应比较质量聚合、分布或显式稳定 key。
permutation_negative_control.rowwise_match_key: none unless an explicit stable material key is declared

cross_resolution.rule: rowwise array matching is forbidden; use source×destination mass aggregates or an explicitly declared stable material key

decision.reason: contract evidence is candidate-only and at least one producer/consumer or destination interface remains open

open_interface_gaps.finding: 直接 CSV→HDF5 转换器只建立 solver 数值身份轴，不建立 protocol 所需的 material/ 组。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 材料 seed/source/质量权重/valid 轨迹必须由显式 material producer 写入；本轮不改生产代码。

open_interface_gaps.finding: trajectory_io.create_partial 本身没有写入 world_frame/time_units/length_units/mass_units；实际 release 依靠 W11 wrapper 后补。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 让 converter 的 protocol output contract 与 materialization wrapper 分层且显式，避免直接消费者拿到不完整 HDF5。

open_interface_gaps.finding: 当前 material writer 调用 advect_hdf5 时没有保存每个 saved interval 使用的积分子步数。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 在 material attrs/manifest 中持久化 integration_method、substeps_per_saved_interval 和实际 substep dt。

open_interface_gaps.finding: 现有 W11 material writer 未把 sidecar barrier_provider 传给 advector；artifact 中 wall_visibility 也不是 true。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 实际场景 material materialization 必须显式链接 sidecar、open-face policy 和 barrier provider。

open_interface_gaps.finding: G4 _load_case 只读取 stable solver fluid identity 和 initial density/pressure/mass，不读取 material/ seed/source/mass_weight。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: material transport 不能复用 particle rollout loader；需新增显式 material input contract。

open_interface_gaps.finding: G4 component features 有距离/法向/Type/壁速度，但没有 open/closed/rim/supporting policy 字段。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: sidecar component 到 G4 的输入必须携带可审计的 open-face/rim/supporting 语义，而非只传几何摘要。

open_interface_gaps.finding: 无 sidecar 时 G4 仍可从静态 AABB 得到 boundary_available；AABB 不能识别开口/挡板拓扑。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 正式 wall-aware material target 必须拒绝 legacy AABB-only geometry，或明确标记为 non-identifiable。

open_interface_gaps.finding: 现有 transport_metrics 对 open lifecycle 把失效 mass 命名为 unknown_exit；trajectory-v0.1 的 closure 必须显式处理 numerical_loss/退出语义。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 为 open-face 穿出提供有符号事件/exit reason；不能把末帧缺失自动解释成 numerical loss 或 physical exit。

open_interface_gaps.finding: 现有 compare_traces 按 trace array 位置做差，API 没有 stable material key 或 resolution-group guard；它只能安全用于同一 HDF5/同一 seed axis 的 cadence/substep 对照。
open_interface_gaps.minimum_interface: 跨分辨率比较必须改为 source×destination mass aggregate 或显式稳定 key；本轮只在 audit negative control 中执行该禁令。

method.cadence: median diff(time) is saved velocity/trajectory cadence; integration substeps are a separate explicit field
method.cross_resolution: source×destination mass aggregates or explicit stable keys; array index matching is forbidden
method.mass_denominator: initial fluid mass / represented initial material mass; failed mass is retained, not renormalized
method.seed_identity: compound (particle_zone, particle_id) key within one HDF5; no array-position seed matching
method.source_destination: only explicit destination specs are executable; legacy world-x bins are never promoted to formal destinations
method.support_failure: terminal material invalidity is reported by initial mass/source; reason attribution is only claimed when persisted evidence exists
method.wall_open_face: sidecar geometry, component policy, material wall_visibility provenance, and candidate/formal admission are separate checks
